questions.prompt: A web route calls get('s-2') and receives the agent. What can it not do with that object?
options: Dispose the agent, because only the handle can
Steer the agent during a turn
questions.explanation: get returns the bare agent. The dispose function lives only on the handle that create or resume returned to the owner.

questions.prompt: Why does resume take a session id instead of making a new one?
options: The session id names the saved file the agent rebuilds from
A resumed agent must have a shorter id
The registry can hold only one agent at a time
Resume skips the session and starts an empty agent
questions.explanation: The id is also the file name, so resume opens that file and rebuilds history and waiting inbox messages from its events.

questions.prompt: Two agents run. The owner of s-2 calls dispose. What does list() return next?
options: 2 agents, because dispose only pauses the loop
1 agent, because dispose removes s-2 from the map
0 agents, because dispose stops every agent
An error, because s-2 still has a session file
questions.explanation: dispose stops the loop, deletes the map entry and removes the scope. Only s-1 stays in the map.
